sup:70530.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kw frequency converter.
Our should-cost estimate for this part is 403.21 EUR (cost:350020).
Our volume forecast for this part is up 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).
Your on-time delivery was 84.6% (sc:70530@2026Q3).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation and would like an agreement that covers our full need.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
For your information:
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
As to the delivery record and volume change and should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length.
We acknowledge your data regarding delivery and volume, and our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown separately.
Although our pricing flexibility is currently restricted, we are able to offer a price reduction in exchange for the improved payment terms and longer contract duration you proposed.
Building on your second package, we propose a revised unit price of €427.48 for a 24-month agreement with 14-day payment terms.
Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

We note that the packages provided in your latest communication are identical to those in your previous email. As our management has frozen price reductions, we cannot lower the price further without a corresponding adjustment in terms. Consequently, we must hold our offer of €432.15 for a 24-month contract with 90-day payment terms.

For complete clarity, our offer stands at a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. Our proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
